- DNS: blox.grudge-studio.com · mine.grudge-studio.com · grudox.grudge-studio.com

### Controls
- WASD move · Space jump · E interact · 1–5 skills · Mouse look

title: Dope Budz Streets
metaDescription: Integrated Dope Budz Streets ECS world — claim session lots, grow and harvest, run terminal routes, drive, and fight across six districts.
markdown:
## Dope Budz Streets

The primary Streets experience runs inside the GrudgeBlox ECS authority.

- Six districts: Grove, Harbor, Neon, Mesa, Fogtown, Little Beach
- Claimable session lots with BUDZ/SOL balances and owner labels
- Timed plant and harvest cycles on grow benches
- Terminal-to-terminal jobs with BUDZ and reputation rewards
- Motor Row cars, street crews, jump pad, and weapon kits

Use the in-game **Street status**, **Owned lots**, and **Current job** controls for live server state. Session progress resets on disconnect until an owner-managed persistence service is configured.

### Controls
WASD move/drive · E enter, exit, or interact · 1–4 kits · mouse look
